theme.rationale: High energy, data-dense, command-center feel for fast technical analysis of meme coins.

layout_spacing.padding: Containers use p-4 or p-6; Tables use compact padding.
layout_spacing.radius: rounded-sm (2px) to maintain a sharp, technical aesthetic.

table.style: Grid Borders (Technical Look). Subdued headers. Row hover state: hover:bg-white/5.
table.text: Data cells must use text-sm and JetBrains Mono.

ai_analysis_panel.style: Glassmorphism Sheet/Modal: backdrop-blur-2xl bg-[#050505]/80 border-l border-white/10.
ai_analysis_panel.indicators: Use Recharts or custom SVG circular gauges. Green for high hype/buy, Red for sell. Give indicators a subtle drop-shadow glow.

icons.usage: Use sparingly. 1.5px stroke width. E.g., Bot, Activity, TrendingUp, ExternalLink.

terminal_grid_bg.description: Abstract dark mode background with glowing green neon grid lines. Use as a low-opacity (opacity-10 to opacity-20) background overlay for the dashboard or specifically within the AI Analysis header section.

testing.requirements: All interactive elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='analyze-btn-tokenname').

instructions_to_main_agent: Create the app using Javascript (.js/.jsx), NO TYPESCRIPT. Start by ensuring proper font imports for JetBrains Mono and IBM Plex Sans in index.css.
Install required dependencies if missing: lucide-react, recharts (for gauges/indicators), clsx, tailwind-merge.
Implement a crypto screening dashboard layout. Top bar: Logo & Title. Right side of top bar: 'Telegram Config' button.
Main Content: Filter controls (Search, Volume Min, 'NEW' toggle, 'HOT' toggle) above a Data Table.
Table Columns: Asset (Name/Ticker), Price, 24h Vol, Holders, TXs, Age, Status (Badges), Actions.
Actions Column: Must contain an 'Analyze' button (triggers AI modal) and a link to DexScreener.
Telegram Bot Config: A Dialog or Sheet that takes 'Chat ID' and 'Bot Token' inputs and saves to a mock environment state. Include a 'Test Alert' button to simulate sending.

AI Analysis Modal/Sheet: When 'Analyze' is clicked, show a panel containing AI-generated mock insights (Hype Score, Community Sentiment %, Buy/Sell %). Use circular gauges or percentage progress bars. Include a section for 'Recent X/Twitter Posts' with mock links.
Apply the specific colors and typography from this JSON, ensuring terminal-like dark mode aesthetics.
